metadata.question: In April 2023, did southern Spain experience temperatures over 90 degrees Fahrenheit?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use ERA5-Land Hourly 2m air temperature (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY) for April 2023 over southern Spain (Andalusia-like bbox intersected with Spain boundary). If empty, fallback to ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed (reanalysis). Compute monthly maximum temperature per pixel and assess threshold exceedance.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: Check collection size (C1), total valid pixels (C2), and region max value existence and plausible range (C3). If valid, decide A/B based on K > 305.372 (90°F).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function getInfo(obj) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((res) => resolve(res), (err) => reject(err));
  });
}

function kToC(k) { return k - 273.15; }
function kToF(k) { return (k - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32; }

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const bbox = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-7.7, 35.7, -1.5, 38.9], null, false);
    const spain = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Spain'))
      .geometry();
    const region = spain.intersection(bbox, ee.ErrorMargin(1000));
    const start = '2023-04-01';
    const end = '2023-05-01';
    const thresholdK = 305.372; // 90°F

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .select('temperature_2m')
      .filterBounds(region);
    let size = await getInfo(col.size());
    if (!size || size === 0) {
      // Fallback
      dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY';
      col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select('temperature_2m')
        .filterBounds(region);
      size = await getInfo(col.size());
      console.log('Primary collection empty. Switched to fallback.');
      if (!size || size === 0) {
        console.log('April 2023 Images: 0');
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found)');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    // 3. Processing
    const monthlyMax = col.max(); // per-pixel maximum hourly 2m temperature
    const scale = 9000; // ~9 km, appropriate for ERA5-Land

    // Count total valid pixels in region
    const ones = ee.Image(1).rename('ones').updateMask(monthlyMax.mask());
    const totalDict = await getInfo(
      ones.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      })
    );
    const totalPix = totalDict ? (totalDict.ones || 0) : 0;
    if (totalPix === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}`);
      console.log(`April 2023 Images: ${size}`);
      console.log('No valid pixels in region at chosen scale.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Pixels exceeding 90°F (threshold on monthly maximum)
    const hotMask = monthlyMax.gt(thresholdK).rename('hot').selfMask();
    const hotOnes = ee.Image(1).rename('ones').updateMask(hotMask);
    const hotDict = await getInfo(
      hotOnes.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      })
    );
    const hotPix = hotDict ? (hotDict.ones || 0) : 0;
    const hotPct = totalPix > 0 ? (100.0 * hotPix / totalPix) : 0;

    // Region-wide maximum value (Kelvin)
    const maxDict = await getInfo(
      monthlyMax.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      })
    );
    const maxK = maxDict ? maxDict.temperature_2m : null;

    // 4. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}`);
    console.log(`April 2023 Images (Hourly): ${size}`);
    console.log(`Region pixels (@~9km): ${totalPix}`);
    console.log(`Pixels >90°F: ${hotPix} (${hotPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);

    if (maxK === null || maxK === undefined || isNaN(maxK) || maxK < 250 || maxK > 330) {
      console.log(`Region Max T: ${maxK}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const maxC = kToC(maxK);
    const maxF = kToF(maxK);
    console.log(`Region Max T: ${maxK.toFixed(2)} K (${maxC.toFixed(2)} °C, ${maxF.toFixed(2)} °F)`);

    const answer = (maxK > thresholdK && hotPix > 0) ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
